answer: I'm sorry about your father. A power of attorney ends when the person who signed it dies, so that route won't work for selling his car. The help center points to a separate article, Selling a car you inherited, but that article isn't available here, so I can't tell you what documents you'll need; please contact a store for those details. In general, selling to Northwind starts with an instant offer online using the VIN or license plate, followed by an appraisal appointment, a roughly 30-minute inspection, and signing the paperwork to get paid.
